title: Citizens form human chain in Hyderabad demanding SIR rollback and CEC resignation

tea.why: Protesters opposed the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and alleged illegal deletion of voters across the country.
tea.want: They demanded the rollback of the SIR and the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
tea.changed: Oct 25: Hundreds of citizens, activists and students formed a human chain and held demonstrations in Hyderabad.

summary: Hundreds of citizens, civil society members, students, and minority community representatives gathered in Hyderabad to protest against the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and the alleged deletion of millions of voters nationwide. Organised by the People Against SIR alliance along with groups such as AIPM, RSV, NAPM, SFI, and AISA, participants formed human chains and waved the national flag near Lower Tank Bund and Dharna Chowk. Speakers and participants criticized the revision process for disrupting livelihoods and causing administrative hurdles for voters whose names were omitted. The protest concluded with slogans demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the rollback of the electoral revision.
demands: Rollback of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls
Resignation and removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Urgent reforms in the Election Commission of India
response: No official response reported in the sources.

crowd.text: 250-300 citizens, civil society members and students

updates.text: Protesters and civil society members gathered near the Makhdoom Mohiuddin statue to form a human chain.
Hundreds staged a demonstration at Dharna Chowk, waving the tricolour and demanding the removal of the CEC.
